title: Sopra Steria Netherlands cannot be sized or navigated while its post-merger integration is in progress
content:
Two of the flag's statements about Sopra Steria Netherlands are about the record rather than the firm: post-merger Dutch revenue is not yet separable, and integration is still in progress with an unstable org chart. Its recorded stack is Microsoft and Salesforce, across public, banking, insurance and healthcare.

Each of those blocks a different decision. Revenue that cannot be separated from the group's makes the size input to the score unreliable, and size is one of only two inputs the mechanical rescore used. An unstable org chart removes the durable owner that outreach needs: whoever holds a platform decision during an integration may not hold it when the structure settles, so effort spent building a relationship can evaporate without any change in the firm's interest.

The practical reading is that this row is time-dependent rather than settled. Its verticals are strong and its Dutch profile matches the pilot's targets, but nothing can be fixed about it until the integration concludes. Its UK sibling is scored separately on the same recorded stack and carries none of these caveats, which is worth remembering before the two rows are treated as one account.
